Pakistan Blames Diwali Fireworks for Lahore Smog; Own Data Suggests Otherwise

Lahore, Pakistan, was ranked the world's most polluted major city by IQAir, with its Air Quality Index (AQI) crossing 600. The Punjab government of Pakistan initially blamed firecrackers set off during India's Diwali celebrations for the toxic air. However, an assessment by a Pakistani air-quality group released the following day found that evidence did not support this claim. This dispute has raised questions about the causes of Lahore's smog. Due to the smog, Pakistan moved the second Sri Lanka test cricket match from Lahore to Rawalpindi.
